steps.title: Opener
steps.rule: Take your opener spot: tanks in front of Garuda, melee at her sides, ranged and healers behind.

steps.title: Mistral Song target moves east
steps.rule: If you have the marker, go east to the healers; everyone else holds.

steps.title: Drag Garuda west, party behind
steps.rule: Party moves west behind Garuda so the Great Whirlwind lands away from the group.

MainTank.rule: Drag Garuda west before the Great Whirlwind.

steps.title: Dodge feathers, avoid Gigastorm
steps.rule: Step out of the feather puddles and keep clear of the Gigastorm spot.

steps.title: Leave Gigastorm, tank centre
steps.rule: Party stacks south of centre for Mistral Shriek.

steps.title: Bubble group
steps.rule: Group up south-west, next to the bubble, for the Friction cleanse.

steps.title: First Friction
steps.rule: Party stays grouped.

OffTank.rule: Step out of the group for the first Friction.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Step out of the group for the first Friction.

steps.title: Stack south
steps.rule: Stack south for the second Friction.

MainTank.rule: Hold Garuda north of the stack.

steps.title: Melee 2 into the bubble
steps.rule: Stay in the stack.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Run into the bubble to cleanse.

steps.title: Melee 1 into the bubble
steps.rule: Stay in the stack.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Run into the bubble to cleanse.

steps.title: Stack south
steps.rule: Stack south; tank north of centre.

steps.title: Dodge feathers
steps.rule: Step to the nearest clear spot on the south side.

steps.title: Stack for Aerial Blast
steps.rule: Stack near centre for the raidwide.

steps.title: Dodge feathers
steps.rule: Step to the nearest clear spot on the south side.

steps.title: Tanks intercept the sisters' songs, party stacks south-east
steps.cue: Suparna and Chirada cast Mistral Song
steps.rule: Party stacks south-east.

MainTank.rule: Stand between your sister and the stack to take her song.

OffTank.rule: Stand between your sister and the stack to take her song.

steps.title: Dodge feathers and tornadoes
steps.rule: Move away from the feathers and the two tornado spots.

steps.title: Stack south
steps.rule: Stack south; main tank north.

steps.title: Stack south, tank far north
steps.rule: Stack south; main tank far north for the sisters' return.

steps.title: Mesohigh tethers
steps.rule: Hold your spot; the tanks take the tethers.

MainTank.rule: Grab the sister's tether on the west side.

OffTank.rule: Grab the sister's tether on the east side.

steps.title: Final stack
steps.rule: Stack south; main tank far north.

steps.title: Dodge feathers
steps.rule: Step to the nearest clear spot.
